statement: The sender's withdrawal of an unanswered event is accepted and the addressee's inbox no longer lists the event, observed through inbox; on pre-fix HEAD the same append is refused as an unknown event type, observed; a mutation removing the sender-only rule is observed accepting a non-sender's withdrawal
A withdrawal whose body is empty or whitespace-only is refused at append and the inbox is unchanged, observed; the mutation removing the reason check is observed accepting it
A withdrawal by any actor other than the sender is refused and the inbox is unchanged, observed; the mutation that removes the sender check is observed accepting it

Reply then withdrawal: the withdrawal is refused; withdrawal then reply: the reply is refused; both observed through append, and the mutation removing the successor rule is observed accepting the second. Separately, a history holding both successors constructed on disk is refused by verifyLog, observed, and the mutation removing that verifier rule is observed accepting it
One completion by the addressee in reply to the withdrawal is accepted and a second is refused, observed; the mutation removing the once rule is observed accepting the second
A self-reply of any type other than withdrawal is still refused under strict relay, observed, and remains refused after the change (no mutation required; this guards regression)
A withdrawal in a free_form thread and in a coordinator_led thread is refused, observed; the mutation removing the mode check is observed accepting it

A real withdrawal event validates against the published v1 schema and is accepted by the verifier, observed; the one-definition control for EVENT_TYPES fails when the schema enum and verifier list differ, observed by mutation
executed= reported from the mutation run covering every mutation named above; proof, completion, schema, bctx, sdk:buildable and sdk:package suites pass; the historical log verifies unchanged
